playalong.title: Play-along
playalong.tip: During play-along, your desktop pet occasionally looks at your screen, comments on what it sees, and may act on its own. You can stop it here at any time.
playalong.state_unavailable: Cannot read play-along status. Check the connection to the play-along service.
playalong.request_failed: Could not confirm the result. Check the current status.
playalong.incomplete: Some steps did not finish. Check the desktop overlays and screen monitoring.
playalong.screen_failed: Play-along was updated, but the screen monitoring status could not be confirmed.
